newsitem.title: UK: Turkey buys 125,000 tonnes heating oil in tender.
newsitem.headline: Turkey buys 125,000 tonnes heating oil in tender.

text.p: Turkey has awarded five cargoes of Turkish 0.5 percent sulphur heating oil totalling 125,000 tonnes to 130,000 tonnes of imports, traders said on Friday.
One cargo went to Nova and another went to Galaxy for delivery Nov 5-9. Three cargoes went to Tempotrade for delivery Nov 10-15, they said.
Turkey had asked for two cargoes.
The award follows the suspension of production on Wednesday of the Atas refinery in the southern port of Mersin in a pricing dispute with the government.
